title: SMOK Novo Axis EZ Pod Vape Kit
description: The Smok Novo Axis EZ pod vape kit delivers an incredibly user-friendly and dependable vaping experience within a slim, highly portable design. Engineered for simplicity and daily longevity, this device is powered by a substantial 1100mAh built-in battery, providing ample power to see most users through a full day of vaping. Keeping track of your battery life is straightforward thanks to the clear LED indicator, and when a top-up is needed, the device supports efficient USB-C charging. Designed to remove the guesswork from your daily routine, the Novo Axis EZ features an intelligent Smart Mode. This sophisticated chipset automatically detects the resistance of your chosen pod and instantly sets the optimal wattage between 5 and 21W, ensuring you receive the best possible performance without any manual adjustments. You can further refine your draw from a tight, cigarette-like inhale to a slightly looser pull using the precise adjustable airflow slider. The kit comes supplied with a 2ml Smok Novo SLR 2.0 pod, featuring an integrated 1.0ohm mesh coil that is perfect for a discreet and highly satisfying mouth-to-lung vape. The pod utilises a highly convenient top-fill design, allowing you to quickly top up your e-liquid without disconnecting the pod from the battery. For the absolute best flavour and performance, we recommend pairing the included pod with 50/50 freebase e-liquids or Nicotine Salts. Complete your vaping experience with smooth, high-quality liquid vape designed for this kit. We recommend using 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid with this kit Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
